items.title: New York Seizes a Dozen Celebrity Deepfake Websites
items.summary: In the biggest-ever legal action against harmful deepfake websites, the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office has seized 12 sites that collectively targeted around 1,200 victims.
items.author: Matt Burgess

items.title: AI Leaders Are Calling for a Slowdown. Trump’s Team Says It’s on Them
items.summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for regulation. The White House seems unlikely to oblige.
items.author: Isabella Ward

items.title: Sexually Explicit Deepfake Sites Target 100-Plus Politicians in Europe
items.summary: An analysis of 160 deepfake websites reveals politicians in 22 countries appear on them. Nearly all of them are women.
items.author: Matt Burgess

items.title: ‘I Like My Big Rat Wife’: Meet the People Using Chatbots to Write Custom Fiction
items.summary: While the publishing industry frets over how authors are using AI, many readers are taking things into their own hands.
items.author: Joel Khalili
